title: Environment Variable Path Resolution - Forensics Tools
problem: Forensics tools fail when accessing user profile paths via environment variables: $env:APPDATA and $env:USERPROFILE expansion fails in command execution context
evidence: Issue: Environment variable expansion not working in execSync context
Pattern: Affects all tools using $env: variables
cause: Environment variables defined in PowerShell profile are not automatically available to child processes launched via execSync. Variables need explicit expansion before command execution

recommended_actions.action: Expand environment variables in Node.js before passing to PowerShell
Use process.env.APPDATA and process.env.USERPROFILE in Node instead of relying on PowerShell expansion
Create path resolution helper function to handle all $env: expansions

notes: Pattern issue affecting 2+ forensics tools. One fix resolves all $env: issues across framework
